messages:
Anya: I want to propose adding a small, machine-friendly `error_code` field to every API error response (in addition to the HTTP status). main goals: better telemetry grouping, deterministic console copy mapping, and simpler i18n keys. thoughts?

Sam: sounds useful. main risk is SDKs that only parse status. suggest feature-gating it behind a preview header and have SDKs gracefully fall back.

Mike: agree on gate. can you show a canonical response shape so infra/ops can validate logs? we also need to decide on namespaces (quota vs routing vs infra) so signals don't get conflated.

Anya: sketch of response shape:

```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
{
  "status": 429,
  "error_code": "quota.user_rate_limit",
  "message": "You exceeded your request rate. Please retry after the indicated time.",
  "retry_after_seconds": 30
}
```

Anya: implement notes: keep `message` for backward compatibility, but make `error_code` the canonical key for dashboards/console mapping. console should map code -> short UX message + "why am I seeing this?" link.

console-ux: UX wants a one-line friendly string + a link. internal `error_code` should drive the mapping table; the UI will surface the code only in a debug panel for SRE/support. we also need translation keys e.g. `err.quota.user_rate_limit.title` / `.detail`.

Devex: SDK plan: server will send field; SDKs should prefer `error_code` when present, otherwise fall back to status+message. add `RawError` wrapper so advanced users can inspect fields. will ship SDK patches in a compatibility branch.

Sam: rollout proposal:
- week0: add `X-RI-Error-Field: preview` header and emit `error_code` for canary tenants
- week2: update telemetry ingestion and dashboards to accept both status and `error_code`
- week4: publish SDK patches to parse `error_code`
- week6: flip on by default and announce migration + migration guide

Mike: routing fallback question: if we fallback to a different model or region we might return 200 + `served_from` header. should we also emit `error_code` for fallback events (e.g., `runtime.fallback_served`) so they are measurable?

Anya: yes. propose namespaces: `client.*`, `quota.*`, `runtime.*`, `infra.*`, `auth.*`. prioritize a GA set of ~20 canonical codes (top error classes).

ops-bot: Deployment scheduled: api-proxy canary tomorrow 09:00 UTC. :white_check_mark:

Sam: telemetry aside: many of our alerts are keyed to status (e.g., 429 spikes). ops can keep status-based alerts for a grace period, but we should add `error_code`-based alerts for actionable signals (e.g., `quota.user_rate_limit` vs `quota.global_burst`).

console-ux: also: do not expose internal codes in the main UI. show friendly copy and a hidden debug panel with the `error_code`, request ID, and links to support. that helps CS and enterprise customers.

Mike: retention/backfill: we can't retroactively add codes to past logs. dashboards should annotate the migration timestamp and avoid mixing pre/post-migration data for ratio charts.

Anya: next steps: I'll draft the canonical code list + console copy table and share RFC link. @Sam @Mike @console-ux please review by EOD tomorrow so we can enable the preview header for canary.

Sam: ack, will review.

console-ux: ack, will prepare i18n keys and text variants.

Devex: queued SDK PRs on branch `sdk-v2-compat`. will open draft PRs after preview is live.

Anya: keeping this thread as the decision record. will attach RFC and mapping sheet once ready.
